description.en: • Put on the heavenly armor and head to the battlefield. • Tentama armor transforms into flame phoenix • Plated parts make it even more dignified. • Comes with clear effect parts to reproduce the special move. • Comes with a jade seal. Molded product x 9, Seal x 1, instruction manual manga included, molding color changed
